messages:
Jordan: Quick sync — customer asked for two items for a mini-pilot: eval-triggered alerts + a lightweight quantization recommendation flow. Can we ship something thin in two weeks?
Mia: Two weeks is aggressive but doable if we scope hard. What are the absolute must-haves for alerts?
Jordan: Musts: 1) alert when an eval metric drops past a threshold, 2) link to the failing prompt set and 3 example outputs, 3) a soft rollback trigger to route traffic to a fallback model. Optional: automated remediation suggestions.
Sam: From infra: eval -> alert plumbing is straightforward but needs a tiny ingestion pipeline and a rules engine. Rough estimate: 5 dev-days + 2 infra-days. Quant recs: we can prototype heuristics quickly but accurate cost/latency estimates need lightweight profiling (3 dev-days).
Lee: Let's set clear acceptance gates: p99 latency impact <= 10% vs baseline, quant suggestion precision >= 75% on our small benchmark, alert false-positive rate < 10% during pilot.
Anita: CS asks for a simple UI card: metric name, delta, top 3 failing prompts, recommended action (retrain/revert/adjust batch size) + CSV export. Pilot rollout to 3 customers only.
Sam: UI card can reuse observability components to cut frontend work. Backend will expose /api/opt/alerts returning simple payload. Example: {"alert_id":"a123","metric":"concordance","delta":-0.18,"top_fail_prompts":["..."],"recommendation":"revert-to-model-v1"}
Jordan: Proposed timeline: Week 1: infra + eval ingestion + basic alerting (no UI). Week 2: UI card + quant prototype + pilot docs and gating.
Mia: Main risks: noisy eval signals -> FP alerts; quant profiling needing many model variants. Mitigation: conservative thresholds, require 2 consecutive eval rounds to fire, quant recs are recommendations only (no auto-apply).
Lee: Decision: require 2 eval confirmations OR manual ack before triggering rollback. Add telemetry to track FP/TP for first 2 pilots.
Anita: Owners: Sam (backend + infra), Mia (eval thresholds + quality), Lee (acceptance), Jordan (PM + customer liaison), Anita (pilot coordination).
Jordan: Short acceptance checklist for launch candidate:
- eval ingestion pipeline storing traces (yes/no)
- alert rules engine fires on synthetic regressions (yes/no)
- UI card surfaces failing prompts + recommended action (yes/no)
- quant recs prototype returns per-model suggestion + estimated cost delta (yes/no)
- docs + runbook for pilot customers (yes/no)
- rollback safety: manual ack OR 2-confirmation rule (yes/no)
Mia: I'll draft thresholds and add a sample prompt set into the repo by EOD tomorrow.
Sam: I'll open infra tasks and leave an ingestion branch by Tuesday morning.
Anita: I'll assemble pilot invite list (3 customers) and a short FP/TP survey.
ops-bot: Reminder: tag deploy requests in #release-war-room 24h before pilot deploy. :bell:
Jordan: Next sync Thurs 10am to validate the first infra demo. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
